thesis: Candelabra of Tawnos multiplies the output of lands rather than producing mana itself, so its power rises with High Tide, Cloudpost, and every land that already taps for more than one.

claims.summary: {X}, {T} targets exactly X lands and untaps them when the activated ability resolves. It is not a mana ability, can target untapped lands, and may be disrupted on the stack. Candelabra became banned in Legacy on June 29, 2026. One untapped Sol Ring supplies two colorless mana. Spending one for Candelabra with X=1 untaps a previously tapped Maze of Ith; the second can face another attacker. Candelabra itself is now tapped, so the maneuver is not limitless without a separate untap engine.

The Odd Anders Kjostvedt U/G Control archive records Candelabra and Maze together in Old School. Separately, Wizards of the Coast banned Candelabra in Legacy effective June 29, 2026, citing problematic combo applications. Former Legacy High Tide and 2026 Tron lists are historical evidence, not current legal Legacy recommendations.
